readings.title: Readings
readings.typeNote: Kept on this device, for each node its own. Until a type is picked, the charge is counted as Li-ion and said with “≈”.
page.gone: This node is no longer on the radio.
page.needsAdmin: This page needs the admin password: sign in again from the profile.
page.signInFirst: Sign in from the profile first.
queue.idleTitle: Nothing is waiting for a reply
access.ownRole: Your own role is not changed from here
access.needsKey: A role change needs the whole key, which only a contact has
access.intro: One request brings back every client the node keeps a role for. Only admins may ask.
access.granted: {name} can sign in as {role} without a password.
access.grantedUnnamed: The contact can sign in as {role} without a password.
access.hint: A client with a role signs in with a blank password. Each change is one {command} command.
access.removeBody: They lose their role on {name}, and sign in again only with a password.
console.radioWarn: This moves the node off your channel from its next reboot. tempradio tries new settings for a while first.
console.passwordWarn: Whoever signs in with the old password is refused from now on. The Settings tab changes the admin password and keeps the saved one in step.
console.tag: The tag the node echoes back
console.wayBack: The commands may have arrived and the answers been lost: the node answers along its own way to you.
console.relearned: {name} knows the way to you again
history.noReply: No reply in {seconds} s. The sensor may be out of range; try again.
history.nothing: The sensor has nothing recorded for this window.
history.intro: One request brings back, for each series the sensor records, its lowest, highest and mean value over the window.
history.hint: The bar spans min to max and the tick is the mean. Each row has its own scale, labelled at both ends. One window is one request.
neighbours.noReply: No reply in {seconds} s. The repeater may be out of range; try again.
neighbours.none: It hears no other repeater directly right now.
neighbours.intro: One request brings back up to ten, in the order chosen above; more come a page at a time.
neighbours.hint: Only repeaters this one hears directly, zero hop, are tracked. The SNR is of the last packet it heard from each; its bar runs from {low} to +{high} dB, the tick marks zero.
search.hint: The repeater calls them on the air; answers take about {seconds} s
search.waiting: The repeater is calling its neighbours · {seconds} s left
search.nobodyWhy: Neighbours with relaying off stay silent, and each answers no more than four searches in two minutes.
search.oldFirmware: This repeater's firmware cannot search for neighbours; it needs an update.
settings.unknown: This node does not know {names}; its firmware may be older.

settings.onTrial.one: {name} is on the new radio settings for {count} minute. Switch this radio to them to reach it; if nobody does, it goes back by itself.
settings.onTrial.other: {name} is on the new radio settings for {count} minutes. Switch this radio to them to reach it; if nobody does, it goes back by itself.

settings.keeps: {name} keeps the new radio settings from its next reboot.
settings.passwordChangedSaved: Admin password changed, and the saved one with it.

settings.notReadYet.one: Not read yet: {count} value, one request each, a few seconds apiece over the air.
settings.notReadYet.other: Not read yet: {count} values, one request each, a few seconds apiece over the air.

settings.radioMoves: This moves the node off your channel. Apply offers a trial first, from which it falls back by itself.
settings.radioMatch: Frequency, bandwidth, SF and CR must match your radio's, or the node goes silent to you.
settings.passwordTooLong: Sign-in reads only {max} bytes; keep it shorter.
settings.writeOnly: Write-only: the node never sends it back.
settings.trialWarn: The node leaves this channel. {button} uses {command}: unless you reach it on the new settings, it comes back by itself.
settings.moveBody: {name} will keep the new radio settings from its next reboot. If this radio is not on the same settings then, you lose it until someone reaches it on site. The {minutes}-minute trial is the safer first step.
settings.passwordBodySaved: From now on {name} takes only the new password for admin sign-in. The saved one is replaced as soon as the node confirms.
settings.passwordBodyUnsaved: From now on {name} takes only the new password for admin sign-in. Keep it somewhere: nothing here remembers it unless you sign in with Remember on.
signIn.unknownRadio: The node does not know this radio, and a blank password lets no stranger in here.
signIn.relearnHint: The node answers along its own way to you and may have lost it. The sign-in goes to the whole mesh: the node forgets its old way and learns a new one, and your route to it stays.
signIn.noReply: No answer from {name}. The node is out of reach, or the way to it does not work: check the route.
signIn.title: Sign in to {name}
signIn.nodes: Repeaters, rooms and sensors in your contacts
signIn.allListed: Every one in your contacts is already in the list. Others appear in the contacts when their adverts are heard.
signIn.tooLong: The node reads only the first {max} bytes; this one is longer.
signIn.blank: Blank works when the node already knows this radio, or lets strangers read.
status.alerts: Alerts the sensor raises reach its admins as messages, in the chat with {name}.
status.alertsUnnamed: Alerts the sensor raises reach its admins as messages, in the chat with it.

status.unreadBytes.one: {count} byte this client does not read
status.unreadBytes.other: {count} bytes this client does not read

status.clockHint: From the sign-in {time}. The node stamps its adverts with it.
status.setClock: Set its clock from this radio
cli.pathHash: hash size less one: 0 is 1 byte
cli.name: name
cli.privateKey: private key, hex; reboot to apply
cli.extraSf: up to 3 more SFs to listen on, e.g. 9 10
cli.time: epoch seconds; the clock only goes forward
